title: El vecino del norte
goal: Read how the 1823 Monroe Doctrine evolved from a defense of Latin American independence into a claimed US right to intervene, and the deep, mutual asymmetry that shaped the relationship.
grammar: Tan... como: comparar poder y tamaño

items: State what President Monroe proclaimed in 1823.
Explain what the Monroe Doctrine transformed into over time.
Describe how the US and Latin America's power compared economically and militarily.
Explain whether this asymmetric relationship involved need in only one direction.
Use tan... como to make an equative comparison of power or size.
